code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if grid[r][c] == grid[r][c+1] == grid[r+1][c] == grid[r+1][c+1] == 2:
                coords = [(r-1,c-1), (r-1,c+2), (r+2,c-1), (r+2,c+2)]
                if all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] in (3,6,7,8) for rr,cc in coords):
                    vals = [grid[rr][cc] for rr,cc in coords]
                    colors = [vals[2], vals[0], vals[3], vals[1]]
                    dirs = [(-1,-1), (-1,1), (1,-1), (1,1)]
                    for (rr,cc), color, (dr,dc) in zip(coords, colors, dirs):
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
                        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                            out[rr][cc] = color
                            rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
    return out
'''
